answer: Because the gale derivation is checked against the haven nonce, the saffron audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 193 aliases produces 193 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 20 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake.
